title: Turn the tags into Releases, plus a screenshot for the Discover route
body: Two suggestions from an external checker: turn the tags into GitHub Releases, and add a Discover screenshot.

title: Git commit messages are scanned as archive invocations
body: The shell pre-execute check refuses a git commit whose message mentions a change path and the word archive.

title: CI: validate on main failed in host-wiring 'run admission at capacity'
body: The validate workflow on main failed in the host-wiring run-admission test, while the same file passes locally.

title: Flaky test: recovery-completion task-review recovery times out on CI
body: The recovery-completion task-review recovery test timed out on the release build of v0.54.0 while the same commit passed on main.

title: pnpm lint fails when the huashu-design skill leaves .huashu-design/ in the workspace
body: pnpm lint reports an error in .huashu-design/<file>.md on a checkout where the huashu-design skill has run.

title: Validators and the machine-path scan walk ignored local worktrees and skill output

title: workflows: task-progress gate cannot be satisfied for a fully checked change

title: plugin-workflows full-suite tests fail intermittently under load (different test per run)
body: Three consecutive full pnpm test runs each failed a different plugin-workflows test, and each failing test passed when re-run alone.

title: workflows: pre-execute guard refuses VCS commands naming a completed change path
body: After a change is moved into the completed-changes directory, ordinary VCS commands naming its path are refused by the pre-execute guard.

title: release: Pages deploy fails on an artifact visibility race and duplicate github-pages artifacts
body: The v0.59.0 release workflow failed twice on a Pages artifact visibility race and a duplicate github-pages artifact.
